dedupe_keys.name: icta mauritius ict observatory internet mobile fixed line international tariffs 2019 to 2025

description: The Information and Communication Technologies Authority of Mauritius publishes an online observatory of the sector with pages for internet, mobile, fixed line, international traffic, tariffs and consumer affairs. The internet page gives annual tables from 2019 to 2025: total, fixed and mobile internet subscriptions, broadband subscriptions and penetration rates; for 2025 it reports 2,241,100 internet subscriptions and a penetration rate of 180.51 percent. A spreadsheet of internet service providers is also linked. Coverage: Mauritius, national annual totals by access type. Format and access: HTML tables and charts, with some Excel files, on the ICTA website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: annual only; national totals, with no operator or regional split on the page read; penetration above 100 percent reflects multiple subscriptions. Simulation uses: demand growth by access type for capacity planning of Mauritian networks, an island system reliant on a few submarine cables. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives the same indicators for comparison; data-telegeography-submarine-cable-map shows the cables landing in Mauritius.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
